name: Inquisitor Foehunter
body:
Most inquisitors pull down the power to judge their deity’s enemies into themselves. The foehunter is tasked with punishing those that dare cross their faith.

Punishment (Su)

At 1st level, a foehunter can bring down a punishment on their foes as a swift action. Starting when the punishment is meted out, the foehunter imposes a penalty or effect on the target based on the type of punishment imposed.

At 1st level, a foehunter can use this ability five times per day. At 4th level and every three levels thereafter, the foehunter can use this ability one additional time per day. Once activated, this ability lasts until the combat ends. The foehunter must participate in the combat to impose these penalties.

If they are frightened, panicked, paralyzed, stunned, unconscious, or otherwise prevented from participating in the combat, the ability does not end, but the penalties do not resume until they can participate in the combat again.

When the foehunter uses this ability, they must select one type of punishment to mete out. As a swift action, they can change this punishment to another type or switch targets. The target must make a Will save DC (10 + 1/2 the foehunter’s class level + their Wisdom modifier). On a successful save or if the target is invalid or immune, the target is not affected by the punishment, but the use of the punishment is not used. Punishments do not stack upon single targets. All of the punishments are considered curse effects. This ability replaces judgement.

Exposure: The target is cursed to always place their protections in the wrong place. The target takes a -1 penalty to Armor Class. This penalty increases by -1 for every five foehunter levels they possess. At 10th level, this penalty is doubled against attack rolls made to confirm critical hits against the target.
Fragility: This punishment makes the target more susceptible to harm. They take 1 additional damage from physical sources. This extra damage increases by 1 for every five levels they possess.
Fumbling: This punishment causes the target to fumble their strikes, imposing a -1 penalty on all attack rolls. This penalty increases by -1 for every five foehunter levels they possess. At 10th level, this penalty is doubled on all attack rolls made to confirm critical hits.
Susceptibility: The target is opened up to the wiles of the foehunter and their allies. They take a -1 penalty on all saving throws. This penalty increases by -1 for every five foehunter levels they possess. At 10th level, the penalty is doubled against curses, diseases, and poisons.
Vulnerability: The target is filled with an energy that reduces their protections by 2. The target takes 2 extra points of energy damage against one energy type (acid, cold, electricity, fire, or sonic) chosen when the punishment is meted out. The vulnerability increases by 2 for every three foehunter levels they possess.
Wasting: The target is filled with an energy that drains their life force. Each round at the beginning of their turn, the target takes 1 damage as long as the punishment is active. The amount of damage increases by 1 point for every three foehunter levels they possess.
Weakness: The target is marked with a curse that weakens their strikes, imposing a -1 penalty on all weapon damage rolls. This penalty increases by -1 for every three foehunter levels they possess.
Second Punishment (Su)

At 8th level, whenever a foehunter uses their punishment ability, they select two different punishments to impose on a single target, instead of one. This only consumes one use of their punishment ability. As a swift action, they can change one of these punishments to another type or switch the target for both. This ability replaces second judgement.

Third Punishment (Su)

At 16th level, whenever a foehunter uses their punishment ability, they select three different punishments to impose on a single target, instead of just two. This only consumes one use of their punishment ability. As a swift action, they can change one of these punishments to another type or change the target for all three. This ability replaces third judgement.
